summary: Added .pmcro/scripts/validate_host_boundary.py: resolves registry paths from an explicit path_base (default skill-root, which removes the registry-or-plugin-root ambiguity in the adapter contract), rejects absolute paths and anything resolving outside the plugin, maps each declared envelope type to a .pmcro schema, checks MAF discoverability of every SKILL.md, and evaluates tool-authority declarations with 'tools' read as what a skill executes and 'tool_authority' read as deference to the Orchestrator. Vendored capability plugins are reported as EXTERNAL rather than judged. The report lists the three capabilities that cannot be checked without a live host and credentials.
